QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_32

question.text: Under item 32 of the Code of Conduct, which of the following is a merchant banker explicitly prohibited from being party to?

answer.text: Creation of a false market or passing of unpublished price-sensitive information
Managing more than one public issue simultaneously
Acting as both lead manager and registrar for the same issue

explanation.text: The Logic: Code of conduct item 32 prohibits a merchant banker from being party to: (a) creation of a false market, (b) price rigging or manipulation, and (c) passing of unpublished price-sensitive information. The Trap: Managing multiple issues simultaneously and combining lead-manager/registrar roles are governed by different provisions, not item 32 of the code of conduct. Note: These prohibitions are listed directly in the code of conduct schedule of the Merchant Banker Regulations.
